Get in touch with RMIT Southeast Asia Hub

Thank you for your interest in the RMIT Southeast Asia Hub.

Please fill in your details and let us know your areas of interest. Please complete this form in English so our team can best support your enquiry.

Personal details





Please enter a valid phone number starting with '+' followed by country/area code and phone number. 


Your preferences



Please include any further details about your organisation or institution and the type of opportunity or support you are interested in.

Submit your response

Disclaimer: RMIT is collecting your personal information for the purpose of sending you relevant information related to the RMIT Southeast Asia Hub, as you are requesting. You can ask to amend your personal information by emailing seasia@rmit.edu.au For further information on how we manage and protect personal information, please refer to the RMIT Privacy Statement.

Acknowledgement of Country

RMIT University acknowledges the people of the Woi wurrung and Boon wurrung language groups of the eastern Kulin Nation on whose unceded lands we conduct the business of the University. RMIT University respectfully acknowledges their Ancestors and Elders, past and present. RMIT also acknowledges the Traditional Custodians and their Ancestors of the lands and waters across Australia where we conduct our business - Artwork 'Sentient' by Hollie Johnson, Gunaikurnai and Monero Ngarigo.
